Name: Treats for Vanilla Animals
Author: TrentXV
Description: Marnie will sell 3 Treats per day, you have a chance of buying a Treat to you Pet. Dinosaur Treats and Wild Berry Treats (Used for Ostriches) will only be purchasable if you have already sold their eggs once (will not appear everyday though).

Downloads.Description: Unzip the files, let the AnimalHusbandryMod be replaced by the one in this file (just replace - DO NOT REMOVE EXISTING Files in your Animal Husbandry Mod Folder).
